dataset_source: NFM-1540 PathB Star-xingyi (2,909 unique PBE compositions)
rd2_reasons: GroupKFold(n_splits=5) by element system returns R^2 = 0.3111 +/- 0.4777 (see energy_predictor_v3.0_groupedcv_metrics.json). The 0.9858 random 80/20 headline and 0.9678 random-KFold CV R^2 were materially optimistic; per-fold spread includes a negative-R^2 fold (fold 4: R^2 = -0.5652). Re-labeled [EXPLORATORY] per NFM-3953 LOW-bucket decision rule. Confidence claims on the production prediction path need revision.

rd3_verdict.rationale: Root cause is a generalization gap (inter-element-system extrapolation at R^2=0.3111+/-0.4777 vs in-distribution R^2=0.9858), not leakage or training-bug. Top two pairwise features (dg_en_radius_distance 0.3635, max_pair_en_diff 0.1798) carry 54% of impurity gain and act as element-system fingerprints that do not transfer to held-out element systems. Pairwise features are non-degenerate across all 2,909 samples (U is in the lookups), so the binary-degeneracy hypothesis is ruled out.
rd3_verdict.immediate_action: Option D: surrogate /api/v1/predict/energy response confidence with grouped R^2 (0.31) and surface an EXPLORATORY warning instead of the in-distribution 0.9858.
rd3_verdict.follow_up: Option A: open NFM-3957 child for energy_predictor_v3.1 aggregates-only retrain (12D, drop pairwise stratum); only ship when its confirmatory grouped-CV R^2 >= 0.80.
rejected_options: Option B (per-element-system specialist models): rejected for v3.x cycle; complicates cold-start story for novel element systems; revisit only if Option A tops out below 0.85 grouped R^2.
Option C (full revert to v1.1): held; v3.1 retrain is cheap enough that it should be evaluated before we revert the version constant.
